ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is an inverted large triangle, and the top is a horizontal straight line. An internal line segment is drawn from the bottom vertex to the top, dividing the large triangle into left and right two parts. At the intersection of this internal line segment and the top horizontal side, the left side is labeled 72°, and the right side is labeled angle 1; the upper right corner is labeled 38°; the bottom angle of the small triangle on the lower right side is labeled angle 2. Reasoning: Because the top side is a straight line, 72° and angle 1 form a linear pair, angle 1 = 180° - 72° = 108°. In the small triangle on the right side, the three interior angles are angle 1, 38°, and angle 2 respectively, so angle 2 = 180° - 108° - 38° = 34°.
